Dry Prosecco or Pinot Grigio

Sangiovese or Barbaresco (Nebbiolo)

Pinot Noir

Quail stuffed with duck sausage, served over creamy polenta with a tangy-sweet cherry mostarda.

Beaujolais or light Pinot Noir
